definitions.gloss: excellent idea; brilliant plan; bright suggestion
definitions.explanation: A particularly good or clever idea or plan. Often used when someone comes up with an unexpectedly effective solution.

examples.japanese: ⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{名案|めいあん}だ！
⟦{何|なに}か→何か：03873_nanika⟧{名案|めいあん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ありません→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Do you have any good ideas?

examples.japanese: ⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{話|はな}し{合|あ}ったら→話し合う：02396_hanashiau⟧、{名案|めいあん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{浮|う}かんだ→浮かぶ：03916_ukabu⟧。
examples.english: When we all talked it over, a brilliant idea came to us.

notes:
USAGE:
{名案|めいあん} is an approving term for a clever or effective idea. It is often used as an exclamation when someone suggests a good plan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {名案|めいあん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{浮|う}かぶ→浮かぶ：03916_ukabu⟧ (a brilliant idea comes to mind)
- {名案|めいあん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ (a good idea emerges)
- {名案|めいあん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{思|おも}いつく (to think of an excellent idea)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{妙案|みょうあん}→妙案：23888_myouan⟧ also means a clever idea, but implies an even more ingenious or unexpected quality. {良案|りょうあん} is a more neutral "good plan" without the emphatic praise of {名案|めいあん}.
